narrative.incident_description: Vulnerability exposure: CVE-2024-21762 matches software on asset BNK-FW-01 (hostname bank-dc-fw01) belonging to Sim Cooperative Bank in the banking sector. The FortiOS version 7.0.13 is within the vulnerable range (>=7.0.0, <7.0.14). The asset is internet-facing and critical (criticality 5). No exploitation has been observed in the stored evidence.
recommended_next_actions: Confirm scope: verify the affected assets and whether the activity/exposure is real.
Preserve relevant logs (CERT-In Directions require ICT system logs to be retained for 180 days).
Apply the vendor patch or mitigation, or restrict exposure until patched.
Hunt for signs of exploitation; if found, reassess reportability (the 6-hour clock starts when noticed).

validation.note: All 5 identifiers/versions/URLs found in the supplied input; no unsupported claims or commands.
